analysis: The trial completed successfully but did not exceed the supplied 0.505 baseline: host macro validation HR@10 was 0.4962, lower by 0.0088. Category HR@10 was 0.510 Movies_and_TV, 0.585 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.355 Electronics, and 0.535 CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics had the lowest absolute score; without category baseline scores, category-level regressions cannot be established. These results do not support the hypothesis that this convolutional configuration improves the macro objective. They also do not isolate architecture from loss, sampling, or optimization effects. Allocated GPU time was 540.81 seconds.
code_summary: Trained one independent causal convolutional model per category. Each network uses 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, jointly learned output biases, and eight residual blocks with dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block contains two causal width-3 convolutions, layer normalization, GELU, dropout, and a learned residual gain. Training uses ordered history windows of length 100, occasional random prefixes, and next-item cross-entropy with 32 sampled training-history-excluded negatives. AdamW uses cosine learning-rate decay and gradient clipping. Validation HR@10 selects one checkpoint per category, with NDCG@10 as a tie-breaker and 25-epoch patience. The generated predictor routes each dataset to its single trained checkpoint; no ensemble or checkpoint averaging is used.
